**v1.6.7 Item 5 (archive label-preservation + adaptive delete-confirm on categories & accounts) `DONE b05087d`** (2026-07-22, booked Sonnet / ran on Opus this session, low–medium effort, on-device verified — emulator, Claude driving, on a paired staging couple). **Part A (label-preservation):** the grill overturned the original "confirm-on-archive warning" premise — archiving should *never* degrade a label. Records ([TransactionsViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/transactions/presentation/TransactionsViewModel.kt)) and Budgets ([BudgetsViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/presentation/BudgetsViewModel.kt)) now feed their **display** name-maps from `observeCategories/Accounts(includeArchived = true)`, so a historical row pointing at an archived category/account keeps its real label everywhere (Analysis already did this — Records/Budgets were the oversight). Pickers stay archived-excluded: Records' `canAdd` re-derived as `accounts.any { !it.isArchived }`, Budgets' editor `expenseCategories` re-filters `&& !it.isArchived`. **Resolves deferred Item 23** toward preservation (no tester-feedback wait needed). **Part B (adaptive delete-confirm):** the previously-unguarded `Delete` action on both [CategoriesScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/categories/presentation/CategoriesScreen.kt)/[AccountsScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/accounts/presentation/AccountsScreen.kt) now opens an adaptive `PlayfulDialog` — with transactions it shows the **exact count** and steers to **Archive instead** (filled/prominent) · **Delete anyway** (red) · **Cancel**; empty entities get a plain "This can't be undone" confirm. Backed by two new DAO counts ([TransactionDao.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/transactions/data/local/TransactionDao.kt) `countByCategory` / `countByAccount` — the account one ORs `toAccountId` so transfer destinations count) surfaced via new `CountTransactionsFor{Category,Account}UseCase`; each VM folds a `pendingDelete` flow into its existing nested `combine` (as a `Triple`) and replaces `delete(id)` with `requestDelete(entity)` → `confirmDelete()`/`archiveInstead()`/`cancelDelete()`. Count noun pluralizes. **Build-time flag resolved, no guard added:** a non-creator deleting a *shared* category/account does **not** wedge sync (unlike ADR-0018 unshare) — soft-delete preserves `couple_id`/`user_id`, authorized by the `_couple` `for all` RLS, same as the already-unguarded archive; only unshare re-stamps `user_id`. No schema/Room change (stays **v26**). +`CountTransactionsFor{Category,Account}UseCaseTest` (JVM/MockK delegation); the DAO SQL — incl. the `toAccountId` transfer-destination inclusion — is verified **on-device** (no JVM Room harness exists, and CLAUDE.md forbids emulator tests in the per-commit gate), with `FakeTransactionDao` + the 5 hand-written `TransactionRepository` fakes updated. `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green. On-device verified (Rose light): archived "Transportation" keeps its label in Records (not "Uncategorized"); category count = 1 (singularized); account count "Cash" = 6 (DB-cross-checked); **transfer-destination inclusion proven** (a Cash→Gotyme transfer took Gotyme's confirm 0 → "1 transaction (incl. transfers)"); "Archive instead" archived not deleted; empty "Maribank" showed the plain confirm. Throwaway ₱50 transfer created + deleted, DB-verified clean. Full detail: [v1.6.7.md](v1.6.7.md) Item 5.

**v1.6.7 Item 8 follow-up fix (bottom bar nav-bar inset) `DONE 44e7fd5`** (2026-07-21, Sonnet, low effort, on-device verified by Alvin on his real device). The Playful reskin's custom `PlayfulBottomBar` (`IponApp.kt`) draws its own plum surface instead of an M3 `NavigationBar`, which had consumed the system nav-bar inset automatically — on 3-button-nav devices the bar drew under the system nav. **v1.6.7 Item 8 Slice 6j (Home-screen widgets restyle) `DONE dbbb1d3`** (2026-07-21, Opus, medium effort, on-device verified — emulator, Claude driving) — **the final sub-slice of the Slice-6 rollout; Item 8 "Playful Pop" is now COMPLETE across every screen + the widgets.** The first (and only) translation of the Playful language into Glance's RemoteViews constraints, where bespoke Path-based leaf squircles and arbitrary gradients aren't renderable. New `PlayfulWidgetColors` in [WidgetTheme.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/WidgetTheme.kt) — since Glance can't read the app's `LocalPlayfulColors` composition-local, it runs the same `playfulColorsFrom` formula over the **static Rose** scheme for both modes and exposes each surface as a system-night-following day/night `ColorProvider` (the same light/dark split `IponWidgetColors` uses). [BalanceWidget.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt): the compact + tall cards go from a flat `widgetBackground` fill to a soft `navSurface`-tinted rounded card (`GlanceModifier.cornerRadius(28.dp)` — the closest RemoteViews equivalent to `LeafShapes`), accent-tinted heart, and the Playful text ramp (`onCardPrimary`/`onCardSecondary`) across the header/amount/account-rows/hint; per-account color dots preserved (fallback → accent). [AddTransactionWidget.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/AddTransactionWidget.kt): the quick-add becomes an **accent-filled rounded "FAB" card** (`accentFill` + 28dp corners + `onAccent` ink) mirroring the in-app accent-squircle FAB, keeping the two widgets visually distinct. Solid tints, **no faux-gradient** (per the plan's grill note). Refresh triggers, `SizeMode.Responsive` (Item 33), and the hard/soft privacy-mask model (Item 32) untouched — visuals only. No schema/Room change (stays **v26**); no new tier-1 tests (pure Glance reskin; the color derivation reuses the already-tested `playfulColorsFrom`). Also folds in a re-runnable on-device check, [scripts/verify-widgets.sh](../../scripts/verify-widgets.sh) (bare allowlisted `adb`; guards multi-device via `ANDROID_SERIAL`; captures light/dark + the eye-reveal repaint; assumes both widgets pre-pinned since Glance can't be pinned from the shell). **v1.6.6 Item 37 Slice 1 (confirm-on-arrival recurring, the free core) `DONE 98c5436` (2026-07-17, Opus, on-device verified):** recurring rules default to **confirm-on-arrival** instead of silently auto-posting. New `recurring_rules.auto_post` flag (default `false` = confirm; migration applied + verified live on staging) — `MaterializeRecurringRulesUseCase` now only processes `auto_post=true` rules; a confirm rule's cursor simply parks. Pending is **derived, never stored** (ADR-0007-safe by construction): `ObservePendingConfirmationsUseCase` computes each confirm rule's due occurrences (`nextDate`..today, 3-month floor auto-skip) minus the deterministic ids already materialized (active or tombstoned) — so a confirmed occurrence drops off the list immediately even when confirmed out of order, without the cursor having to move. `ConfirmOccurrenceUseCase` posts a single occurrence (optional per-occurrence amount override, rule template untouched, idempotent); `SkipPendingOccurrenceUseCase` advances the cursor past a specific date. UI: a **"Post automatically" toggle** (off by default) in the recurring editor, and a new Records **"To confirm"** card (self-hides when empty; per-row Confirm w/ inline amount tweak + Skip, plus Confirm all/Skip all). Two correctness fixes folded in pre-commit from an edge-case pass: **Skip only appears on each rule's oldest pending row** (`skippableOccurrenceIds`) — Skip moves a single cursor, so offering it on a later occurrence while an earlier one of the same rule is still pending would silently strand the earlier one; and **the card's amount respects the global Privacy mode (Item 15)** — each row keeps its own eye (visually unchanged from a plain per-row toggle) but the tap writes through the one global `SetPrivacyModeUseCase` flag (not a local reveal), so any row's eye masks/reveals every amount app-wide, matching the Accounts/Analysis eye precedent. Room **v25 → v26** (`AutoMigration`, `autoPost` column default `false`). +37 tier-1 JVM tests (pending derivation, confirm idempotency/override/no-cursor-move, skip date-awareness, skippable-ids, comma-amount parsing, mapper round-trip, materialize-auto-only). On-device verified (emulator, Alvin driving + confirming): editor toggle, confirm with inline tweak, skip, auto-post rules still post silently, a 3-occurrence card with skip correctly gated to the oldest row only, and the global privacy eye revealing/hiding the card plus the transaction list together. **Slice 2 (premium forecast layer) `DONE 9e9db99` (2026-07-17, Opus, on-device verified):** the forecast layer on Slice 1's free core — a derived-only `ObserveUpcomingUseCase` (forward window, all non-paused rules, no materialized-exclusion) feeding a Records **"Coming up"** preview (next 14 days, premium; degrades to a count-only upsell teaser when `RECURRING_FORECAST`-locked) and an Analysis month-end **projected Net** (pure `ProjectedNetCalculator`, both-sides, current-in-progress-month only, replaces the "Last month income" band-aid when a schedule exists, forecast-labeled; a lock teaser when locked). New `RECURRING_FORECAST` `Feature` gated via the existing `observeLocked(INDIVIDUAL)` seam (same scope as the S10 Analysis gates) — **dormant** (both surfaces show fully pre-flip). Flow's pace-projection relabeled "At this pace" to disambiguate. ADR-0007-safe by construction (pure add-on, nothing stored). No schema/Room change (stays **v26**). +8 tier-1 JVM (`ObserveUpcomingUseCaseTest` + `ProjectedNetCalculatorTest`); `testStagingDebugUnitTest` (**993 total**) + `assembleStagingDebug` green. ADR debt from Slice 1 (new confirm-on-arrival ADR + ADR-0035 amendment) still open. Full detail: [v1.6.6.md](v1.6.6.md) Item 37.

**Critical sync bug fixed 2026-07-14 (Item 30, `DONE 24a0b5b`, on Opus — on-device confirmed):** batch upserts were NULLing not-null columns. supabase-kt's default JSON serializer hard-codes `encodeDefaults = false` (confirmed via 3.6.0 AAR bytecode), so any DTO field at its Kotlin default was omitted from that row's JSON; in a batch `upsert` Postgrest unions the present keys into one column list and writes literal `NULL` for rows missing a key, bypassing the column `DEFAULT` and violating `not null`. A push batch mixing `transactions.is_settlement` true/false rows (the `false` rows being defaulted → omitted) blew the constraint and — Postgrest bulk insert being all-or-nothing — wedged the whole ~215-row outbox on Alvin's device. Fix: the Postgrest plugin now gets its own `KotlinXSerializer(Json { encodeDefaults = true; ignoreUnknownKeys = true })` in `core/network/SupabaseClient.kt` — one change covering all 8 exposed defaulted not-null columns (`is_settlement` ×2, `is_premium`, `entitlement_source`, `is_paused`, `rollover_enabled`, `is_pinned` ×2, `is_conflict_copy`, `is_netting`) and any future one. Proven safe: all 15 RemoteSources push via full-row `.upsert()`; no partial `.update()` exists to be affected. +3 `IponPostgrestJsonTest`. No Room/schema change (stays **v25**). On-device the fixed build pushed the backlog to **0 pending across all tables**. **886 unit tests green.**

**Non-paywall fix shipped alongside — v1.6.5 Item 29 (coach-mark tour bleed + ring padding) `DONE 8ba95b0` (2026-07-14, Sonnet, on-device verified):** two tutorial bugs found by Alvin — a tour armed on one screen stayed "active" after navigating away, so its ring/tooltip kept drawing (at stale coordinates) over whatever screen came next and blocked that screen's own first-visit tour from starting; separately, `CoachMarkOverlay`'s ring was drawn flush against the target's raw layout bounds with no padding, clipping into label text/button edges. Fix: `CoachMark.kt`'s screen-target modifier now unregisters its bounds on dispose and the ring draws with a 6dp outward inset; `TutorialViewModel.dismissForNavigation()` ends a tour (unseen, so it re-arms later) without marking it seen; `IponApp.kt` watches the active step's target via `snapshotFlow` and calls it once the target disappears. No schema/Room change (stays **v25**). No new tests (pure Compose overlay/lifecycle wiring); `testStagingDebugUnitTest` green. Full detail: [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 29.

**Non-paywall fix shipped alongside — v1.6.5 Item 20 (sign-out "Unsynced changes" wedge) `DONE a689597` (2026-07-11, Opus):** root-caused live on testdev15's device (a non-creator un-sharing a partner-created shared account stamped the partner's `user_id` onto a row RLS forbade that device to push, wedging the whole atomic accounts batch → sign-out). Fix is three client-side parts: **creator-only un-share** (repo guard + hidden "Make personal" via new `Account.isCreator`/`Category.isCreator`), a **flip-model push ownership filter** (`isLocallyPushable` in `core/sync`, overriding `dirtyRows()` in the accounts/categories/**budgets** syncers so an un-ownable row can never wedge a batch — also self-heals existing poison rows + the unpair-race F1 residual), and the ADR-0021 sign-out guard left unchanged. **ADR-0018 amended** (un-share is creator-only; unpair's server revert unchanged). No schema/Room change (stays **v25**). Audited: only accounts + categories had the bug (goals/notes are owner-retained; budgets/partner-debts couple-scoped either-partner-pushable). 804 unit tests green. Full detail + audit: [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 20. **Partner-debts/payments follow-up — `DONE aad6e4d` (2026-07-11, Opus):** the F1 residual deferred out of `a689597` for the two always-couple tables (`partner_debts`/`partner_debt_payments`) is now closed with the same push-ownership approach. Straight pattern-following (no grill) — but these are **not** flip-model (`couple_id` NOT NULL, no `user_id` flip), so they get a sibling predicate `isCoupleRowPushable(coupleId, myCoupleId)` in `core/sync` rather than reusing the flip-model one; payments (no `couple_id` of their own) resolve their couple via `debt_id -> partner_debts.couple_id`, mirroring the payment RLS subquery exactly. Push-selection only — never mutates a row/id/`counterDebtId`/`isNetting` and keys off `debtId` (as RLS does), so netting convergence is untouched. Client-side only, no schema/Room change (stays **v25**); **+8 tests, suite 804→812 green**. Full detail: [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 20 follow-up section.

Added a **"Show archived" toggle** to Manage → Accounts + Categories (observe `includeArchived = true` + a `showArchived` flow packed with `upsell` to keep `combine` at 5 args; archived rows render dimmed with a "· Archived" tag). The toggle is gated on a new `hasArchived` flag so it only appears when meaningful — **but still appears when the active list is empty** (recover an archived-only-item). **Net assets computed over active accounts only** so revealing archived rows never moves the figure. **Non-paywall feature shipped alongside — v1.6.5 Item 16 (Reset finances / "Restart fresh") `DONE e1c01b2` (2026-07-12, Sonnet, on-device verified) — re-grilled + scope-reversed same day:** a Settings → Profile → Account "Reset finances" action that **zeroes the numbers but keeps the whole configuration**. Two owned-row mutations, atomic in one `LocalTransactionRunner.run` (a testable seam over `IponDatabase.withTransaction`) then one push: **soft-delete the user's transactions** + **zero `opening_balance` on their personal accounts** (archived incl., shared couple accounts skipped via a null `user_id`) — so balances read ₱0 once the ledger empties. **Kept untouched** (the reversals): budgets (spent → ₱0 for free, being derived), recurring rules (deterministic-UUID materialization can't resurrect a wiped occurrence + catch-up already advances `next_date`, so no backfill), **savings goals + all contributions/progress** (accumulated value, never fed balances, and the *only* part that would have reached shared couple data — so keeping it makes reset touch **zero** partner data), plus categories, notes, couple state. Both mutations run through a new generic `core/sync/bulkRestamp` (fetch owned → per-row monotonic stamp → upsert; **replaced the earlier `bulkSoftDelete`**, reusable by a future delete-account). Gated by password re-auth (`AuthRepository.signIn` before touching anything) **plus an explicit online-only block** — a new reusable `core/network/ConnectivityObserver` (reactive `observe()` + one-shot `isOnline()`) live-disables the confirm with a "need internet" hint while offline (Level 1), instead of the implicit re-auth `NETWORK` error. **Re-grilled 2026-07-12** after Alvin's first on-device test flagged that it landed on *opening balance* (he wanted ₱0) — the grill reversed the original ADR-0037 shape (which preserved opening balance and also wiped budgets/recurring/goal-contributions). **ADR-0037 + `CONTEXT.md` amended** to the new "zero the numbers, keep the structure" design. No Room/schema change (stays **v25**). Tests: reworked `ResetFinancesRepositoryImplTest` (own transactions soft-deleted + own accounts zeroed incl. archived; partner/shared/already-deleted untouched; account survives as a row; single-transaction) + `ResetFinancesUseCaseTest` (password re-auth gate); **853 unit tests green**. Full detail: [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 16.

New `feature/accounts/domain/usecase/ObserveNetAssetsUseCase` extracts the "sum active accounts' derived balances" formula out of `AccountsViewModel`'s inline fold (ADR-0011, active accounts only, via `AccountBalanceCalculator`); `AccountsViewModel` was refactored to consume it too, so Accounts and Analysis now read one shared source instead of two copies that could drift. `AnalysisViewModel` wires it — plus a new `togglePrivacyMode()`, the same shape as `AccountsViewModel`'s Item 15 wiring — via its own outer `.combine(...)` steps, mirroring the existing `showPairingCard`/`individualLocked` chained-combine pattern rather than growing the per-period combine. No Room/schema change (stays **v25**). +5 tier-1 JVM tests (`ObserveNetAssetsUseCaseTest` — cross-account sums, archived-exclusion, a transfer-touching-an-archived-account edge case); `testStagingDebugUnitTest` (847 total, 0 failures) + `assembleStagingDebug` green. On-device verified by Alvin: the header matches Accounts' figure and the eye icon toggles in sync with the Settings switch and the Accounts eye icon. Full detail: [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 14.

**Non-paywall feature shipped alongside — v1.6.5 Item 6 (Delete account, Google Play policy requirement) `DONE 9e0614e` (2026-07-13, Opus, on-device verified):** the Play-mandated in-app account-deletion path — the **one sanctioned exception to ADR-0010** (never hard delete). Grilled to build-ready first ([ADR-0045](../adr/0045-delete-account-hard-delete-rpc.md), which holds the design + every open-question resolution). A single `delete_account()` SECURITY DEFINER RPC (infra migration #19, applied + verified live on staging) dissolves the couple **first** via the existing `unpair()` (so the partner is cleaned up the normal way — reverts, realtime bell, replica purge; their own data untouched — verified against `WatchUnpairUseCase`, which keys off the partner's *own* `couple_id`→null, not the couples tombstone the cascade hard-drops), purges the caller's `storage.objects` rows (the FK cascade can't reach Storage — it has no FK to `auth.users`), then `delete from auth.users where id = auth.uid()` — letting the verified `ON DELETE CASCADE` graph physically remove `public.users` + every owned row + GoTrue's own session tables, all in **one atomic transaction**. **No edge function** (verified live: `postgres`, owner of the existing RPCs, holds DELETE on `auth.users`/`storage.objects`). Client (`feature/settings`): `DeleteUserAccountUseCase` (password re-auth gate) → `AccountDeletionRepositoryImpl` (RPC = **point of no return** → best-effort `AuthRepository.clearLocalSession()` [new, throw-free local teardown via `client.auth.clearSession()`] → `NonCancellable` wipe-with-retry) → `SupabaseAccountDeletionRemoteSource`; Profile gains a destructive "Delete account" row + Item 16-pattern dialog (**online-gated** via `ConnectivityObserver` — no offline attempt ever; unpair notice when paired); WorkManager-cancel before the RPC; **deliberately no `pushOnly()` first** (unpushed edits are about to be deleted; a wedged push must never block deletion — Item 20's lesson). **Storage simplified to RPC-only** (Alvin's "don't make it complicated" — the RPC makes files permanently inaccessible; orphaned physical blobs are unreachable + KB-scale; the grilled client-side Storage-API pre-delete was dropped). Re-registration with the freed email works by construction. **No Room/schema-version change (stays v25).** +6 tier-1 JVM tests (re-auth gate ×2; teardown ordering ×4); `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green. On-device verified by Alvin. **Follow-up fix `22d7cc1` (2026-07-14, Opus, on-device verified — testdev19 fully deleted on live staging):** the shipped RPC silently failed in practice — `storage.objects`' Supabase-platform `BEFORE DELETE` guard trigger (`storage.protect_delete`) rejects direct DELETEs even from this `SECURITY DEFINER`/`postgres` function unless the transaction-local GUC `storage.allow_delete_query` is set `'true'` first; the rejected storage delete aborted the whole transaction (incl. the `auth.users` delete), so nothing deleted. Fix = `set_config('storage.allow_delete_query','true',true)` before the storage delete (SQL-only, no client change; migration `2026-07-14_fix_delete_account_storage_delete.sql` applied live + `schema.sql`). **Still pending (Alvin, manual — the web half of the Play requirement):** a static `delete-account.html` on the legal GitHub Pages site + the Play Console Data safety form URL. Full detail: [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 6.

**Non-paywall feature shipped alongside — v1.6.5 Item 18 (Display-currency symbol) `DONE 834e0eb` (2026-07-13, Sonnet):** a per-user cosmetic display-symbol setting (₱ default; $/€/£/¥/₩/₹/฿) that swaps the rendered glyph app-wide — **display-only, no per-account currency or FX** (every amount keeps the same underlying value). Mirrors the Item 15 privacy-mode slice: a pure `CurrencySymbol` enum (`feature/settings/domain/model`, sibling to `ThemePalette`; 8 **distinct-glyph** currencies since it's cosmetic/no-FX), an own `currency_prefs` DataStore repo + `Observe/SetCurrencySymbolUseCase`, and an app-wide `LocalCurrencySymbol` provided from `MainActivity` that `money()` now branches on. Settings → Currency swatch-grid picker (₱ pre-selected, instant write-through). **Scope expanded past the doc's "money() chokepoint only"** to relabel every user-visible ₱ — the ~10 `"Amount (₱)"` input-field labels (new `currencyGlyph()` composable), the widget quick-add (its own composition root, given its own provider), and the Analysis calendar chart's compact cells — since leaving those hardcoded would read as a bug once a non-₱ symbol is chosen. Audited that no other formatter bypasses `money()`. Combined view uses the **viewer's own** symbol (per-device, not reconciled across the couple). **Onboarding entry split to Item 27.** +6 tier-1 `CurrencyFormatTest` cases; `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green; no schema/Room change (stays **v25**). Not on-device verified at commit. **Follow-ups booked same day (found during this slice):** Item 24 (calendar-chart privacy-mask leak — a pre-existing Item 15 gap), Item 25 (privacy-on-by-default at app open), Item 26 (reset dialog `₱0` copy → symbol), Item 27 (onboarding picker). **Non-paywall UI fix shipped alongside — v1.6.5 Item 24 (Analysis calendar privacy-mask leak) `DONE 52fb40d` (2026-07-13, Sonnet, on-device verified):** the Analysis → Calendar sub-tab drew its per-day income/expense amounts on a Canvas via `DailyNetCalendarChart.compactAmount`, bypassing the Item 15 global "Hide amounts" mask (`money()`/`LocalPrivacyMode`) — so with Privacy mode ON the calendar still showed real daily amounts (a pre-existing Item 15 gap, surfaced while building Item 18, which had threaded the display *symbol* through this same formatter but deliberately left the mask out). Fix mirrors Item 18's glyph threading: capture `LocalPrivacyMode.current` in composable scope and pass it into `compactAmount`, which now returns a short `•••` token — **keeping the sign + row colour** (green income / red expense), never the peso value or glyph — when masked. Chose `•••` over a blank cell to match the app-wide "mask the value, keep the context" behaviour (a blank cell would also hide *that* a day had activity). Pure Canvas UI wiring — no test added (private draw helper, verified by running per Testing Policy), no schema/Room change (stays **v25**). `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green. On-device verified by Alvin. Full detail: [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 24.

**Non-paywall feature shipped alongside — v1.6.5 Item 10b (Budget cycle start day) `DONE 618cc25` (2026-07-14, Sonnet-class/built on Opus, on-device verified):** a "Budget month starts on day N" Settings row (5 presets — 1st/10th/15th/25th/End of month) for PH payday-aligned personal budgets, per **[ADR-0046](../adr/0046-budget-cycle-start-day.md)**. Mechanism: `Budget.yearMonth` stays an opaque cycle-key label; a new pure `BudgetCycle` object (`cycleKey`/`window`) reinterprets only which transactions bucket into it and what date range it displays, with short-month clamping (day 31 = last day of month) keeping consecutive cycles gap/overlap-free — zero schema/Room change (stays **v25**). `startDay` threads through `BudgetProgressCalculator`, `CheckBudgetAlertsUseCase`, and a split `BudgetAlertWorker` (personal budgets on the cycle, the shared couple budget forced to calendar `startDay = 1`, since a per-user cycle can't bind a two-user row); `BudgetsViewModel` re-anchors the stepper to the current cycle on open and shows a date-range header ("Jul 15 – Aug 14") when day ≠ 1. New local-only `finance_prefs` DataStore (privacy-mode pattern — the partner never sees personal budgets, so no synced column). +11 tier-1 JVM tests (incl. a full-year day-30 contiguity sweep and a shared-budget-stays-calendar pin); `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green. **On-device verified** (emulator, Medium_Phone AVD, testdev15@iponlove.com — a real paired-couple staging account, Claude driving at Alvin's request): preset dialog, instant persistence, correct cycle re-anchor, rollover chain carrying correctly across the cycle boundary on real transaction data, the shared couple budget staying calendar-independent, and full retroactive reversibility. Full detail: [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 10.

**Post-V1 Horizon** — the only work beyond the numbered versions above, unscheduled by design (could land before or after production launch depending on priority/capacity). Reconciled 2026-07-04 against `PRD.md`/`ARCHITECTURE.md` (which had drifted out of sync with each other and with this list — see `v1.6.1.md` Item 5):

1. **Google Sign-In** — Supabase OAuth + Android Credential Manager. **Target: Q3 2026.**
2. **Facebook Login** — Supabase OAuth + Facebook SDK. **Target: Q3 2026.**
3. **AI companion** — hybrid, not pure BYOK: a capped, app-funded free tier (cheap model, e.g. Haiku, small monthly message allowance) for the mass-market sub-features (smart insights, NL transaction entry), with BYOK (user's own Anthropic key, encrypted on-device) as an opt-in unlock for unlimited/heavy chat use. New `feature/ai` module. Not yet designed/grilled — greenfield. Revised 2026-07-05: pure BYOK was rejected because the target audience (couples budgeting, PH market) is non-technical and won't self-serve an API key, which would leave the feature effectively unused; the hybrid trades some cost predictability for actual adoption. Possible sub-features: financial companion chat, smart insights, NL transaction entry, receipt OCR. **Target: not yet determined** — greenfield, not yet designed/grilled.
4. **Password vault** — ❌ **MOVED to [deferred.md](deferred.md#password-vault)'s Shelved shelf, 2026-07-18** (no active interest). Was: new `feature/vault` module, SQLCipher/EncryptedDataStore.

Distinct from Horizon #11 "Delete my account" (they share only a generic bulk-soft-delete helper). See [v1.6.2.md](v1.6.2.md) Item 1 for the full grilled design. **Target: Q3 2026** — the most build-ready item on this list.

15. **Premium paywall + feature gating** — the monetization model, now settled: Love, Ipon monetizes via a **one-time ₱249 Google Play in-app purchase** for **Premium** (pivoted 2026-07-07; the brief 2026-07-06 subscription plan was reverted — one-time won on the AI-cost and PH-market-adoption arguments). **Designed & grilled to build-ready** (five passes, latest 2026-07-08) — both of the hard, app-specific questions are **resolved**: *lapse policy* → **freeze** (over-cap data stays visible + read-only, block-on-create, never deleted), and *couples governance* → **either-partner-unlocks-both**, propagated via an `is_premium`/`premium_until` field on the synced `users` row (read through the redacting partner view; realtime just accelerates it). The free-vs-premium split is a **generous-free** map (own-money tracking + couple pairing always free; Premium = higher caps, extra palettes, calculator, recurring calendar, deep history) with a concrete `Feature`/`PlanLimits` code contract; entitlement is cached offline-first, no live billing check per launch. **Ads dropped (2026-07-08, grill #5)** — no ad tier; `NO_ADS` parked dormant. The 5th pass also pinned the entitlement *mechanism* (client-trusted advisory column, cache-of-Play, fail-open cold-start, cap-counting = archived-counts, per-instance shared/individual scope, `entitlement_source` beta-comp guard) → **ADR-0044**, with domain terms in `CONTEXT.md`. **Full spec: [subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md)** (§8 feature map, §9 architecture D1–D8, §10 build spec, §11 mechanism seams G1–G10 + ADR-0044). Sequencing: build the entitlement infra **next (dormant, kill-switch OFF, everything unlocked)** *ahead of* most other Horizon items so unbuilt paid-candidate features (#8 fonts) are born gate-aware; flip enforcement on only after beta. **Ordered slice plan (resume-able across convos): [subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md) §12** — a tick-box build order. To start/continue in a fresh convo: `/orient`, then *"continue the paywall build — next unchecked slice in subscription-paywall-design.md §12."* One-concern-per-commit still holds (the paywall is ~a dozen slices, never one commit; wire-only gates grouped by mechanism). **AI (#3) monetization — resolved (2026-07-07, D8):** a separate credits add-on (starter allowance + consumable top-up packs + BYOK), **server-metered** via a Supabase Edge Function (paid credits can't be tracked client-side); not bundled into one-time Premium; stays deferred behind the dormant paywall infra. **Target: Q3 2026** — teased on the tester-facing Upcoming features screen 2026-07-07 (the "Subscription plans" teaser wording should move to "Premium" to match the one-time model); internal gating specifics stay internal-only.

## July 2026 Build Roadmap (provisional)

**Build order for the Horizon items, decided 2026-07-06. Build starts Jul 7.** Schedules **13 of the 15** Horizon items — **#4 (Password vault) and #6 (website/webapp) are deferred out of the July runway** (no demand signal / greenfield-and-large respectively); they stay on the Horizon list above, unscheduled.

**Sequencing rules:** (1) **#15 leads** — premium (one-time ₱249) gating infra must land before any feature it gates (#8 custom fonts). (2) **#15 is grilled to build-ready** ([subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md) §9–§10) and **#3 AI's monetization is resolved** (D8 — separate server-metered credits add-on + BYOK); the remaining #3 work is the *feature* build (Edge Function proxy, prompts, credits infra) — still a long pole, start it day 1. (3) Non-gated items fill the remaining weeks.

|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Jul 7–13 | **#15** premium gating infra (**grilled ✓** → build dormant, kill-switch OFF) · **#13** restart-fresh · **#14** display-currency symbol | #15 is the substantial work; #13/#14 are already-scoped no-grill fillers. **#15 grill done (one-time ₱249); kick off #3 AI grill day 1.** |

### Paywall ↔ V1.6.5 sequencing (added 2026-07-07 — remove once paywall infra ships)

The two initiatives run **in parallel, not sequentially** — neither blocks the other from starting (full reasoning: [subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md) §6/§10.2).
- **Paywall dormant infra** (`core/billing`, `core/entitlement`, `FeatureAccess`/`PlanLimits`, paywall screen — kill-switch OFF) is fully grilled (D1–D8) and can start immediately; nothing in [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) blocks it.
- **v1.6.5.md's 18 items** are almost entirely independent of the infra and can be picked off in any order around it.
- **The only touchpoints:** Items 2/3/4 (records stepper, analysis ranges, notes char limit) need their *base behavior* built before their *tier-split gate* gets wired later — not before the infra starts. Item 12 (Premium Settings entry) is really part of the paywall build itself, not a separate slice.
- **Practical order:** finish grilling v1.6.5.md (in progress) → start the paywall infra build (the long pole — "day 1" per the July roadmap above) → thread the ready v1.6.5.md items in around it, in any order.

### supabase-kt 3.x API notes

- `upsert(rows: List<T>)` is a `suspend fun` returning `Unit` — no `.execute()` chaining.
- `select { filter { gt("col", cursor) }; order("col", Order.ASCENDING); limit(n.toLong()) }.decodeList<T>()` — `select {}` returns a builder; `decodeList<T>()` executes.
- `WorkManager.enqueueUniqueWork()` requires `OneTimeWorkRequest`, not `WorkRequest`.

### Per-feature pattern

Copy from any existing feature. `feature/x/` → `data/local` (Entity impl `SyncMeta` + DAO), `data/remote` (Dto `@Serializable` + RemoteSource port + `SupabaseXRemoteSource`), `data/XMapper.kt` (toDomain/toDto/toEntity), `XRepositoryImpl`, `data/sync/XTableSyncer`; `domain/model|repository|usecase`; `presentation/`. Then: add to `IponDatabase` + bump the Room version, add the DAO to `DatabaseModule`, add `XModule` (`@Binds`), add the route to `IponApp`.
